snippet.title: outlol — free multiplayer football and foosball in the browser
snippet.description:
Eight players, five phones and three laptops, one match. Then the same eight at a foosball table.

Play free: https://outlol.bid

A physics football game that runs in any browser, in 2D or 3D, with a foosball table mode. Host a field, send the link, and everyone plays from their own phone or laptop. No install, no account.

Football: arrows or WASD to move, X or Space to kick. Foosball: slide the rods, hold kick to charge the shot. On a phone, a stick and a kick button.

Everything in the film is the game itself: the football match was played in eight browsers over the game's own network code, and the foosball match on its own table, both by scripted players.
